name: QuickBooks
one_liner: Intuit's QuickBooks Online accounting product, exposed through an OAuth 2.0 accounting API.
auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 with client ID and secret; one-time browser authorization, then refresh token. Intuit does not offer per-user API keys.
access_notes: Requires an app registered on the Intuit Developer Portal and a QBO company to connect. Sandbox company is available from the dev portal. Production needs a public HTTPS redirect. Cost and wait time are not stated in the fetched pages.

buildability.rationale: Sandbox setup is straightforward and the official MCP server runs locally over stdio, but production OAuth needs a public HTTPS redirect and a one-time browser handshake. Refresh tokens lapse after a 100-day window.

identity.quote: A comprehensive Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for QuickBooks Online

auth.quote: This server uses OAuth 2.0 to authenticate to a QuickBooks Online company.
Intuit does not offer per-user API keys.

access.quote: complete a one-time, browser-based OAuth handshake.

sandbox.quote: production requires a public HTTPS callback for the initial authorization.

api_surface.quote: It includes full CRUD operations for 29 entity types and 11 financial reports

mcp.quote: This MCP server provides complete QuickBooks Online API integration for Claude Code and other MCP-compatible clients.

needs_human_reason: Access cost and approval wait are not stated in the fetched pages. The developer docs page returned only a loading placeholder, so the official API docs were not verified.
